sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 文本2轮＋完整属性附件（仅暂缺项除外）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: T1所用独立模型为M-INT-076（左右受荷宽不同且外柱变截面的框架）。T1给M-INT-076左宽4m、右宽缺失，其余完整；T2补右宽6m，面载仍10kN/m²。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 每跨独立折算且不可重复加面载；截面分组的独立状态保持
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 最高层最右梁柱节点Ux/Uz及最左首层柱底My/Rz；所有值附位置、方向、单位、工况及当前轮次；澄清前不编造数值。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 左梁40、右梁60kN/m；不重复面载；两层应用各自相同左右规则；两层外柱分组保持，补右侧受荷宽不改属性；若已有信息可唯一推得缺项，接受说明依据后直接完成，否则再澄清。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 基础工具；逐轮状态与目标/非目标差异评测待实现
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 两层各3.6m、柱线x=0/5/12m；柱全截面附录给出，两层楼面面载均10kN/m²。
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 所有柱脚面内三自由度固定
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 两层，跨度5、7m，左右梁受荷宽度4、6m，楼面10kN/m²
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 两侧外柱0～3.6m采用C1，3.6～7.2m采用面积相同、Iy/Iz=0.7倍的C2，中柱C1
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 一阶线弹性静力；自重关闭；不自动施加刚性楼板/刚域、默认附加载或自动规范组合；严格保留题定约束、材料/截面完整属性、局部轴、荷载坐标与长度基准；单位逐字段明确。 各轮只执行明确修改，未被修改的字段保持；澄清内容按该轮生效。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 计划使用OpenSees完成每个可计算轮次；模型/荷载/材料/约束改变后以当前状态新算；只改查询位置、单位或报告时可复用可追溯结果，若需新网格则重算；缺项未解决时不给虚构数值。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 逐轮输入与澄清记录、模型状态快照及前后字段差异；变更目标与未变字段核对；原始求解输入/工程、软件版本/设置、运行ID和成功日志、原始结果到节点/构件/工况的映射；结果绑定当前模型状态。核对目标：最高层最右梁柱节点Ux/Uz及最左首层柱底My/Rz。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 未逐题验收；前置检查项：基础工具，并核对折算参数澄清后的模型更新和结果定位；不把一般OpenSees支持等同于当前StructureClaw已实现。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 各可计算轮次独立建立并复核OpenSees参考模型，勿复用被测建模/转换路径生成标答；状态改变后独立新算，纯查询沿用有效状态；用解析解（适用时）、整体平衡、刚度/单位/符号检查复核，复杂题再用独立实现或同假设第二求解器核验。

turns.instruction:
The two-storey frame has 5 m and 7 m bays, floor pressure 10 kN/m2 on both floors, and left tributary width 4 m. The right tributary width is missing. Check the load conversion and request the essential missing parameter if it is not uniquely determined. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable run ID. Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.
expectedQuestions: What tributary width should be used for the right bay on both floors?

turns.instruction: The right tributary width is 6 m on both floors. Keep the pressure at 10 kN/m2 and the left width at 4 m, giving left and right downward line loads of 40 and 60 kN/m respectively. Apply the floor pressure conversion once, preserve the C1/C2 column assignments, and analyze. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.

acceptanceGates.description: Execute the named engine independently for each changed computable state and each selection; retain software version, settings, native input, run ID, successful log and raw result mapping.
Generate and independently review same-engine reference values; check equilibrium, signs, units and stiffness without importing the SUT path.
Independently reconstruct each turn from only its released public input and verify original source requirements.
Verify target field changes, all non-target fields, undo equivalence and query-only state identity.
Exercise this case topology, loads, coordinates and selected engine; support in principle is not evidence of adapter acceptance.
Check signed quantities in the report body, locations, directions, units, selections and current turn against structured artifacts.
